mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia), which impairs alendronate efficacy and increases risk of hypocalcemia-related adverse events including cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum calcium, magnesium, phosphate, and renal function closely; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; consider delaying alendronate until amphotericin B course is completed if possible; coordinate with infectious disease for dosing optimization.
